sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the next word of a line they haven't seen ('come in and go out and find ___'). Nothing in the earlier cards points to 'pasture' over 'water' or 'shade'. Sheep also find water and shade, so a baker could argue a wrong answer is right. The only way to get it right is luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. / The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen. / No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.
